claims.statement: An advertisement says Tom Allen's Free Concert Hall at 417 Washington Avenue is open every evening, with the champion presiding.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen's Free be orga Hall, 417 Washington avenue. Best place amusement in the city. Open every evening. Champion will preside.

notes: The hall's name is partly garbled in the scan ('Free be orga Hall'); 'Concert' comes from the title.
